entities.summary: Ibn Ādjurrūm and his full name: Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn Muḥammad ibn Dāwūd al-Ṣanhādjī. (1273–1323) was a Moroccan grammarian and Islamic Scholar and master of Quranic Recitation from Fez famous for an Arabic synoptic grammar.
